summary: Master advanced capacity and demand planning. Learn S&OP, IBP, and predictive modeling to optimize supply chain performance. Enroll at TrainingCred today.
lede: Capacity planning training helps supply chain and operations professionals match forecast demand with available resources. The course develops practical skills in statistical demand forecasting, mapping capacity constraints and bottlenecks, and aligning supply, demand and financial plans through S&OP and Integrated Business Planning. It also covers demand sensing and inventory positioning to support planning across production and distribution networks.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the strategic and operational alignment of supply and demand within complex global organizations.
modules: Advanced Statistical Forecasting and Demand Modeling
Strategic Capacity Planning and Resource Optimization
Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and S&OP Alignment
Demand Sensing and AI-Driven Predictive Analytics
Supply Chain Resilience and Constraint Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in supply chain, operations, or demand planning roles. A working knowledge of basic statistical concepts (mean, standard deviation) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis are required. Prior exposure to S&OP processes or ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) is highly recommended.
